## The claim

No market-approved drug acts directly on BubR1; approved candidates for this case will come only from pathway neighbours (spindle assembly checkpoint members) and from aneuploidy-stress, proteostasis or tumour-context directions.

**Prediction if true.** Open Targets knownDrugs for BUB1B, ChEMBL mechanisms for human BUB1B targets and DGIdb interactions for BUB1B return zero molecules with max_phase 4 (approved); approved molecules appear only for other targets in the expanded set (for example AURKB, KIF11, PLK1, TTK, HDAC1-3, HSP90AA1, MTOR, PRKAA1).

**What would refute it.** Any molecule with an approved status (ChEMBL max_phase 4 or an FDA label) whose recorded mechanism of action names BUB1B/BubR1 as the target.
